text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I've kept running from the Mejiro name. But not because I hate my family or anything.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I ran because I'm so proud of them. I thought I wasn't worthy. That I wasn't good enough.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (But even when I turned my back on them…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (They still supported me. They told me to run even harder if I felt guilty for not being enough. They told me I could find a different way to be strong.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Today, I'm gonna take the answer I found…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna face them head-on again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer! Let's go, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Time to go wild and bring the ultimate party by being the ultimate me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, McQueen. Let's use today to really show everyone how strong Mejiro Umamusume are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We may be facing a lot of competitors today, but there's no way we're losing to any of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But of course. We have a story that only we can tell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The story of our noble path and those we must overcome in order to walk it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Don't you think that's, like, kinda boring?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If it's that noble, only the hero or heroine from the very beginning of the tale can win, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Palmer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I have my own story to share too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's a little different from the others… but it's a Mejiro story all the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer stands in the middle of the paddock and looks out at the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The runaway slay, Mejiro Palmer, is in da house! ☆ Thanks for coming, everyone! By the way, did you all know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I used to be mad cringe. I couldn't take it, so I ran away from the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If I'd stayed, I wouldn't have been able to keep going. But after I ran away…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I met my bestie and my trainer. They helped me turn things around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I started from scratch, found my own way of running, and owned it. And it's taken me all the way to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I never had any pride. I was a coward who turned my back on everything and ran.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But now… I'm proud of myself! I ran from the Mejiros I love so much, mulled everything over and over, and then, finally…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I found a strength that's equal to McQueen and Ryan's very own, although it's not the type of strength you typically expect from a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not just friendship that Mejiro Palmer's found. She's found strength from that friendship as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's given her the strength to persevere even when things are tough. It's a strength she's gained from enjoying herself while she and Helios pushed each other to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I may have run away, but that's not all! I've been searching the entire time I was away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I searched for a strength I never would've found if I'd stayed! And for the parts of myself that would have always been hidden from my sight by the blinding light of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: My trainer and bestie taught me that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And that's why I'm here today! I've come to face the Mejiro family head on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In the past, no one had a glance to spare for me. It wasn't worth anyone's time to look at me. But not anymore!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Take a good look, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The black sheep of the Mejiro family who ran off with her tail between her legs has found the strength to stand before you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I may be the black sheep, but I'm still a Mejiro! I'm the Mejiro who walked a path no one else could!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There's nothing wrong with having a different story! There's nothing wrong with starting your story as a complete nobody!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I have a story where weakness turns into strength! And today…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: As a Mejiro! Here and now! I'm gonna slaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true that she may not be the kind of Mejiro that people tend to look up to. That said…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She is also unmistakably a drop of sunlight sprung forth from the distinguished Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, McQueen… Palmer is certainly different today…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. She's become a Mejiro beyond all of our imaginations…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You killed it, queen! ☆ And look at you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're totes fine, even on your own now. You've got nothing to worry about with those aura points of yours! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you think so? But honestly, you're the reason I've gotten to the point where I could say all that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So thanks, bestie. Thank you for everything before and everything to come. ♪ Now, let's finish this and win together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bet! ♪ Whatever happens, the two of us are on the same vibe! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's distance will certainly be difficult for Daitaku Helios. Still, their dream is unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer stands at the gate as the ultimate partyer, supported by the bonds of friendship and her own self confidence.
